bioParagraphs: I bridge the gap between speculative design and rock-solid production code. Over the last 8 years, I have architected web systems and sensory interfaces for venture-backed startups, research labs, and frontier AI companies.
My work is rooted in buttery 60fps micro-interactions, mathematically rigorous typography, kinetic layout engines, and zero-compromise developer ergonomics.
When I step away from the IDE, you will find me experimenting with modular analog synths, contributing to open-source shaders, and analyzing brutalist architecture.

projects.title: Aetheris AI Canvas
projects.subtitle: Next-Gen Generative Visual Pipeline & Neural Agent Workspace
projects.shortDesc: An infinite drag-and-drop workspace for chaining multi-modal AI agents, vector memories, and live inference pipelines in real time.
projects.overview: Aetheris AI Canvas was designed for frontier AI engineering teams needing an intuitive node-based IDE to visualize, inspect, and benchmark multi-agent systems.
projects.challenge: Rendering hundreds of reactive nodes with bidirectional data pipes and live data streams while maintaining a strict 60fps frame budget across desktop and tablet devices.
projects.solution: Built a custom canvas reconciliation engine decoupling visual node state from heavy worker-thread LLM streaming payloads, resulting in zero UI thread stuttering.
achievements: Scaled to over 240,000 active monthly researchers across 12 countries
Featured on Product Hunt as #1 Product of the Day and #1 Product of the Week
Reduced workflow iteration time by 68% compared to traditional code-only agent chains

projects.title: Aethelred Core Telemetry
projects.subtitle: High-Frequency Holographic Cloud Infrastructure & Financial HUD
projects.shortDesc: Real-time enterprise HUD visualizing global server clusters, latency telemetry, anomaly detection, and cross-border currency settlement.
projects.overview: A mission-critical control center interface built for autonomous systems monitoring, combining 3D spatial globe telemetry with ultra-low latency charts.
projects.challenge: Displaying continuous 100Hz tick updates from 18 edge datacenters without CPU throttling or memory leaks over 24-hour persistent browser sessions.
projects.solution: Implemented WebGL-accelerated chart shaders and ring-buffer data structures in WebAssembly to offload calculations from the JavaScript garbage collector.
achievements: Awarded Behance Award Winner for Outstanding Systems Design
Zero memory growth over 72-hour continuous stress tests

projects.title: Auralis Spatial Workstation
projects.subtitle: Browser-Based 3D Ambisonics Sound Synthesizer & Waveform Matrix
projects.shortDesc: An intoxicating generative sound laboratory mapping frequency spectrums into 3D reactive particle meshes and binaural head-tracked spaces.
projects.overview: Auralis brings professional spatial audio engineering directly to the web with zero plugins, allowing musicians and game designers to position sound sources in spherical 3D space.
projects.challenge: Achieving sample-accurate DSP timing and low audio latency while simultaneously rendering 60,000 audio-reactive particle points on GPU.
projects.solution: Created custom AudioWorklet processors running on dedicated audio threads paired with WebGL instanced geometry shaders driven by shared audio buffer telemetry.
achievements: Nominated for Webby Award in Experimental Web Experiences
Used by soundtrack composers for indie game releases
99.8% crash-free session stability across all major browsers

projects.title: Neo-Vault Prime Protocol
projects.subtitle: Biometric Web3 Multi-Signature Asset Interface & Security Console
projects.shortDesc: Next-generation institutional treasury dashboard with hardware-grade biometric passkey authentication and interactive multi-party approval workflows.
projects.overview: Combining cyberpunk luxury visual polish with impenetrable cryptographic safety protocols, Neo-Vault Prime redefines high-value decentralized custody.
projects.challenge: Simplifying complex multi-signature threshold cryptography and gas simulation into a seamless, high-confidence executive user experience.
projects.solution: Designed biometric WebAuthn integration paired with transaction simulation sandboxes that visualize fund movements and state changes before on-chain execution.
achievements: Secured over $131 million across 4 EVM chains without incident
Featured on CoinDesk and Decrypt for groundbreaking UX standards
Cut user signing error rate to essentially 0%

faq.q: What is your typical project engagement structure?
faq.a: I work on both fixed-scope architectural builds (2-8 weeks for high-impact MVPs/microsites) and embedded staff-level engineering retainers for select tech teams.

faq.q: Can you handle both UI design and full-stack code?
faq.a: Yes! I pride myself on bridging design engineering and production architecture. I frequently take projects from blank Figma canvas through database schema, API design, animations, and zero-downtime deployment.

faq.q: What timezone do you operate in?
faq.a: Based in Pacific Time (San Francisco, UTC-7/8), with flexible collaboration hours accommodating teams across North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific.

faq.q: How can we kick off a collaboration?
faq.a: Use the contact page form or email me directly at aura.vance.dev@gmail.com with a brief summary of your timeline and goals. I usually reply within 24 hours.
